update-manifest-error: Could not verify the release information.

update-permission-error: The app does not have write permission.
update-integrity-error: The file size or checksum does not match the release information.
update-download-error: The download stopped. Check your internet connection and try again.
update-prepare-error: Could not prepare the update. Check access to the installation folder.
update-package-unavailable: There is no update package for this variant of the app.
update-restart-confirmation: Your current session will end. The app will reopen after updating.
update-manual-explainer: Download the arm64 DMG from the release and compare its SHA-256 with the verified value below. Quit Find a Note, then open the matching DMG and replace the app in Applications.
update-macos-pending: An update is waiting for you to finish or restore it.
update-macos-preparing: Verifying and preparing the macOS app. Find a Note will close when it is ready.
update-macos-confirm: Close Find a Note and install the update? macOS may require Open Anyway in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
update-macos-manual-location: This app location cannot be updated automatically. Use the verified DMG to update manually.
update-macos-gatekeeper: macOS may block the new version on first launch. After verifying the download, you can review the warning in System Settings → Privacy & Security. If macOS offers Open Anyway, decide whether to allow this copy. Keep the previous version until the new one opens.
update-ready-explainer: The update was downloaded and verified. Restart to finish installing it.

calibration-save-error: Could not save the range. Your settings are preserved. Try again.
